tools.name: check_token_risk
tools.description: Returns a 0-100 safety score, on-chain insider wallet clusters (wallets sharing a first funder), mint/freeze authority status, holder concentration, and live price/liquidity/volume for a single Solana token mint. Use before recommending or executing a trade on any Solana token. 5 free MCP calls/day,

tools.name: check_token_risk_batch
tools.description: Same as check_token_risk but for up to 25 mints in one call — N mints charged as N calls, same per-call economics as check_token_risk, no bulk discount. All-or-nothing: if the batch can't be fully covered by remaining quota/credit, the whole batch is rejected rather than partially processed.

tools.name: get_token_risk_history
tools.description: Returns hourly historical data points (safety_score, insider_cluster_count, holder_count, price, liquidity, volume) for a mint over the last N days (max 90). Free and unmetered — no quota, works with or without an API key — pure read from stored history, no live upstream call.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_token_risk · Private data: check_token_risk, check_token_risk_batch, get_token_risk_history · Public sink: check_token_risk.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_token_risk · Private data: check_token_risk, check_token_risk_batch, get_token_risk_history · Public sink: check_token_risk

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_token_risk" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
